name: Shazzrah
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/molten-core/shazzrah.md, corrected by docs/research/molten-core/VERIFICATION.md. Era 40-man: 351,780 HP, no adds. One 200 s phase: the fight is a loop punctuated by Blink. Blink / Gate of Shazzrah: the live teleport is 23138 (DBM, BigWigs). First about 30 s then every 41-50 s (every 45, jitter 4). Modelled as a `targetSwitch` that teleports him to the raid (`teleportBossTo`), a hidden `threatWipe`, and a follow-up Arcane Explosion on the group he lands on. The tank spot sits on the north side so that when the tank walks him back he settles on his own spot. Arcane Explosion: 20 yd, 800 Arcane in Classic (Wowhead Classic 19712; 30 yd and 925-1075 are TBC values), 0.5 s cast, cadence every 5-9 s (cmangos, using 6.5). The engine measures radius from his edge, so the circle reaches 24 yd from his centre, and ranged and healers stand just outside it. Modelled as `aoe` radius 20 with a `playerMetric` for ranged and healers (standing inside it is the mistake); the tank and melee eat it by design. A Blink lands him on the raid, so ranged catch an explosion or two until the tank walks him back; that is the real cost of the Blink, so it is scored lightly (1 per hit). After a threat wipe the Taunt bonus is raised to 700 so the tank keeps a lead over the first attacks while walking him back. Melee: real raids either keep melee out until 5-10% (classic, wiki and Ten Ton Hammer) or stack them on the tank (wowtbc.gg). The script uses the stack so melee have work to do; the tip names the alternative. Shazzrah's Curse: +100% magic damage taken (`damageTakenMult` 2, on physical melee too because the engine cannot separate the schools), 5 min, Curse, 45 yd (DBC) vs 35 yd (Wowhead TBC, wiki), cadence every 21-26 s per DBM (every 23.5, jitter 2.5). A Curse debuff the healer removes. Debuffs on others are only dispelled when the player is the healer, so the 10 s `duration` stands for the raid's decursers. Counterspell: a non-dispellable debuff that lands on you about 30% of the time. It is a 10 s school lockout in the real fight (radial 45 yd in DBC; one Wowhead comment says frontal, unverified) and the engine has no silence, so the lockout is the tip and the timer rather than a game effect. Magic Grounding / Deaden Magic: a 30 s self-buff (-50% magic damage taken) removed by Dispel Magic or Purge. Cadence unconfirmed: DBM and BigWigs track only its 30 s duration; 35 s (cmangos) vs ~10 s (guide), using 22. The engine has no boss buffs, so it is a Magic debuff on the raid (it never lands on you) that the healer dispels. It stands for "purge it off him". Boss melee 350 per 2 s is a placeholder scaled to the 10,000 HP tank; caster bosses swing weakly and the real danger is Arcane Explosion plus the curse. Engine gaps: no boss buffs, no silence or school lockout, no group spread, and DPS are not scored for attacking during a Blink (the bot stops anyway). A greedy DPS is only punished through threat.

labels.text: Ranged and healers: 20 yd out from his edge, four groups

tankSpot.label: Tank: north of him, so a Blink walk-back ends on his spot

rangedSpot.label: Ranged: outside the 20 yd Arcane Explosion

healerSpot.label: Healers: outside Arcane Explosion, in range of the tank

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Stand him in the middle of the raid. Every Blink wipes the table and drops him on someone else: run to him and Taunt the moment he lands, then walk him back. You eat every Arcane Explosion, so be the first one decursed.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stack on the tank and eat the Arcane Explosions, or, in the classic strategy, stay out until 5-10% and Execute. Stop the moment he blinks: resume when a tank has him. Decursed players take half as much.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stay 20+ yd from him so Arcane Explosion cannot reach you, and stop the instant he blinks. Casters: stop casting a second before each Counterspell and use instants or your wand while locked out.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Decurse first (a cursed player takes 1600 per Arcane Explosion), keep the tank up, and purge Deaden Magic off him. Stay outside 20 yd of him and time your heals around the 15 s Counterspell.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment he turns on the raid, never while he is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Removes the oldest dispellable debuff on the raid. Here one button stands in for Dispel Magic, Cleanse, Remove Curse and Remove Lesser Curse.

arcaneExplosion.label: Arcane Explosion
arcaneExplosion.tip: 800 Arcane to everyone inside 20 yd, every few seconds, and straight after a Blink. Ranged and healers stand outside it.

blinkExplosion.label: Arcane Explosion (Blink)
blinkExplosion.tip: The Arcane Explosion straight after a Blink hits whoever he landed on: the group he blinked to takes it.

blinkGate.label: Blink
blinkGate.toast: He blinked and wiped threat. Stop DPS until the tank has him!
blinkGate.tip: He leaps onto a random raid member, wipes threat and casts Arcane Explosion. Stop DPS, tank runs in and Taunts, then everyone goes again.

blinkWipe.label: Gate of Shazzrah
blinkWipe.toast: Threat wiped. Tank, get him back!
blinkWipe.tip: The threat reset that comes with the Blink.

shazzrahsCurse.label: Shazzrah's Curse
shazzrahsCurse.tip: Everyone within 45 yd takes +100% magic damage for 5 minutes. Decurse tanks first, then the melee, then the rest. Mages and Druids do this.

counterspell.label: Counterspell
counterspell.tip: Interrupts everyone in 45 yd and locks that school of magic for 10 s. Casters stop casting a second before the timer; healers keep an instant ready.

deadenMagic.label: Deaden Magic
deadenMagic.tip: He reduces magic damage taken by 50% for 30 s. A self-buff: purge it, or the casters lose half their damage. Here it is shown as something the healer dispels.

expectations.label: Take him in the centre of the circle
expectations.tip: Let the hunter pull him to you, then Taunt him in the middle of the raid so the ranged groups are all past 20 yd.

expectations.label: Get him back after every Blink
expectations.tip: Blink wipes all threat. Run at him and Taunt the moment he lands; the raid is holding DPS until you have him.

expectations.label: Stay out of Arcane Explosion
expectations.tip: It reaches 20 yd. Stand at the edge of your range: a hit is 800 Arcane, 1600 if you are cursed.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Decurse fast, tank first
expectations.tip: A cursed tank takes 1600 per Arcane Explosion. Decurse them first, then the melee.

expectations.label: Purge Deaden Magic
expectations.tip: He halves incoming magic damage for 30 s. Dispel Magic or Purge it the moment Detect Magic shows it.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Every Arcane Explosion lands on the tank too. Heal through the steady damage and top them up after each Blink.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in fire
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the fire before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up
debuffSeconds.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tanks first.

cues.notes: Press notes: Taunt when he blinks; Dispel the curse and Deaden Magic; Heal when the tank is low.

list.label: Taunt when Shazzrah turns on the raid
list.tip: The moment he turns, Taunt. Every second he is on the raid someone is dying.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

drills.name: Blink recovery
drills.description: Already on him. A Blink every 15 s: run at him, Taunt the moment he lands and hold him while the Arcane Explosions keep coming.

drills.name: Range and Blink discipline
drills.description: Stay outside 20 yd through the Arcane Explosions and stop your attacks the moment he blinks.

drills.name: Decurse race
drills.description: The curse every 8 s, Deaden Magic every 18 s and steady Arcane Explosions: clear everything inside the window and keep the tank up.
